Ran 21 commands, read memory, shared files
Phase 18 is done. positional-phase18.tar.gz contains only the 8 changed or new files. Extract it at the repo root.

What changed

New DelayedTask (decorations/utils/DelayedTask.kt): a cancellable delayed action that runs in a given coroutine scope. The same file adds a CoroutineScope.child() helper that creates a child scope backed by a SupervisorJob.
GoogleMapView and OsmMapView:
The Handler is gone. On resume, each map creates a resumedScope as a child of the panel’s lifecycle scope. The preference flows and the 500 ms heading sensor registration both run in it.
On pause the scope is cancelled, which stops all of them together. The separate preferenceJob and the removeCallbacksAndMessages call on destroy are no longer needed.
The onPaused hook was only used for the trail auto center, so I removed it.
OsmTrailMap and GoogleTrailMap: auto center is now a DelayedTask in resumedScope. If the camera goes idle while the map is paused, nothing gets scheduled.
build.gradle: adds kotlinx-coroutines-test:1.11.0 as a test dependency, so the timer tests use virtual time instead of real waits.
DelayedTaskTest covers:
the task runs once, exactly after the delay;
scheduling again restarts the delay;
cancel stops a pending run;
nothing runs when there is no scope;
cancelling the child scope stops the task but leaves the parent running;
cancelling the parent also cancels the child.
README.md: phase 18 is marked Done, and the architecture notes and test list are updated. I added phase 19 as Next: read the display rotation through ContextCompat.getDisplayOrDefault instead of the deprecated defaultDisplay.
There are no files to delete. I couldn’t build here because there’s no Android SDK, so CI will be the first compile and test run.
